已经不能下单了，只能减仓
多单、空单都不可以下新订单 https://t.co/B5Rn8UvOkT
其实不是，和做市商无关。是bn在0.038-0.028接管了做多的仓位，那一笔是在0.06-0.05补过保证金的（仓位很大名义价值超过100M），然后就adl了大部分的空仓把自己敞口做平，从0.028之后一直是自动化程序接管双向平仓，一个小时不到只剩下20M不到的名义价值。后面就是市场自然博弈了，后面20M的合约很难影响到2B的市值就震荡阴跌走势了。

items.summary: WLFI闪崩后，USD1在币安USD1/USDT轻微脱锚至0.9981，其流通量30天缩水约27%至28.28亿美元。BlockBeats称储备由BitGo持有或管理，暂无兑付危机证据，后续需关注多平台折价及1:1赎回是否畅通。
items.author: BlockBeatsAsia

evidence.quote: Binance 平台 USD1/USDT 交易对近 1 小时下跌 0.26%，现报 0.9981 美元。与此同时，USD1 过去 30 天流通规模已缩水约 27%，最新市值降至 28.28 亿美元，一个月蒸发超 10 亿美元。
不过，WLFI 的投资亏损与 USD1 的兑付储备是两回事。根据官方披露，USD1 的储备资产包括美元存款、短期美国国债及政府货币市场基金，由 @BitGo 持有或管理。项目方抛售 ETH 亏损，并不意味着稳定币储备出现缺口。
目前尚无证据表明 USD1 存在兑付危机，但在流通规模持续收缩、治理代币闪崩、项目方大额亏损抛售的背景下，市场信心正在面临考验。
接下来需要关注的是，USD1 是否会在多个交易平台持续出现折价，以及 BitGo 的 1:1 赎回渠道能否保持畅通。

items.summary: cfm_sol称HEY已宣布扩展至Base，计划再覆盖Ethereum与Solana；持有约500美元HEY可解锁Research Terminal，付费安全审查计划2027年1月1日上线、1000美元起。作者提醒记录数不等于研究质量，重点看付费单量、Terminal留存和外部MCP用量。
items.author: cfm_sol
items.new_information: Terminal持币门槛、付费审查计划，及作者的风险与跟踪指标

evidence.quote: According to the official update, holding approximately $500 worth of HEY unlocks Terminal access, with a minimum holding value of $450 required afterward and a one-day grace period. This makes the token an access pass to a premium research product, rather than just a payment method.

More importantly, HEY is beginning to monetize its research services directly. The team plans to launch paid Security Reviews on January 1, 2027. Free reviews will remain available until then, with free requests closing on December 15 to allow the team to clear its existing queue. Paid reviews will start at $1,000. Holders receive priority in the queue, and

Multichain expansion is another important development. HEY initially tracked only RH Chain, but it has now announced an expansion to Base. Notably, the team did not wait for the official Base launch to start working. It had already been tracking project Releases, Deploys, and Changelogs for weeks. The official launch simply makes those records public.
Ethereum Mainnet and Solana are planned next.

There are still meaningful risks. First, 8,190 Ships do not represent 8,190 high-quality projects, and a growing number of records does not guarantee that research quality is improving at the same pace. Second, multichain expansion increases the cost of data collection, verification, and maintenance, and coverage across Base, Ethereum, and Solana will need

The four metrics I care about most are the actual number of paid Security Review orders, Terminal holder addresses and renewal retention, external MCP usage, and the growth and evidence quality of Verified Builders across different chains. These are much better indicators of a sustainable business than project listing counts or X engagement alone.

items.summary: gkisokay按Hyperliquid precompiles在Elysium可实现的六类场景筛币，买入Tokos、Symbolon（symb）与Implied。他称无法核实团队、池子小，故仓位较小；precompiles上线前这些功能都无法运作，他在等其上测试网。
items.author: gkisokay
items.new_information: 按precompiles场景筛出三币及小仓位理由

evidence.quote: PropAMMs, 0DTE options, lending sized by how deep the books are, credit against your Hyperliquid positions, free oracles and strategy vaults.
None of it works until the precompiles are live, but the projects building the right thing now have a head start when they are.
• $Tokos puts Hyperliquid funding onchain every hour and lets you trade it as a fixed or floating rate. That makes it the oracle slot and a product on top of it
• Symbolon $symb gives every perp-only coin on Hyperliquid a spot leg backed 1:1 by the real coin, and runs a basis vault that earns the funding.
• Implied sells options on BTC, ETH, HYPE and NVIDIA, filled on Derive and paid on Elysium. It's the loosest fit to Hyperliquid, but it's in the same lane.
I couldn't verify the teams, and these pools are small, so I sized them that way. If the precompiles hit testnet these are the best technical fits I found, and the desk is watching for that date.

items.summary: Casper777_eth把稳定币脱锚分为两类：储备可兑付的流动性恐慌（如2023年USDC）是套利窗口，底层信用崩塌则是陷阱。他认为USD1筹码集中、赎回透明度弱，二级市场低价买入不等于能按1美元赎回，挤兑时赎回先到先得。
items.author: Casper777_eth
items.new_information: 区分流动性恐慌与信用崩塌，质疑USD1赎回可得性

evidence.quote: 稳定币每年都有脱锚，但分两类：
一类是流动性恐慌型，基本面没问题，是套利窗口，比如2023年硅谷银行USDC，当年SVB危机能修复，核心是储备可兑付，这就是典型的流动性恐慌，必须抄底，必须狠狠套利。
另一类是底层信用崩塌型，是死亡陷阱。
USD1不属于USDC那种强合规标的，把它的脱锚直接当成“送钱抄底”，赔率很差。
USD1筹码高度集中、赎回透明度弱，脱锚的风险完全不在一个级别。二级市场低价买入≠一定能按1美元赎回：如果挤兑潮起来，赎回是“先到先得”，后面的人拿不到美元，折扣就永久锁死￼￼￼。
